title: Ranj Na Ho Mera Bhira Be Kafan Laasha Tera
body:
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaire Khanjar Kar Ke Sajda, Kar Gaya Tu Inteha
Paa Ke Rasiyan Jang Di Kardi, Paiya Veeran Ibteda
Sir Dai Vich Khaake Shifa, Burka Waala Da Bana
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Mangdi Ay Val Val Ijaazat, Teer Da Deva Jawab
Dhup Utay Baithi Hai Kurte, Chaake Asghar De Rubab
Uthdi Nayi Asghar Di Maa, Ki Karaan Veeran Dasa
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Dais Baigaana Hai Veeran, Vekh Main Majboor Haan
Kar Nayi Sakdi Dafan Tenu, Main Vatan Ton Door Haan
Koyi Vi Nayi Aasra, Mera Abid De Siva
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Zainab Nu Teri Kufay Di Shaahi Bul Gayi
Vekh Is Kufay De Vich Aulaad Teri Rul Gayi
Ya Ali Mushkil Kusha, Dhiyan De Parde Bacha
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Saabra Da Rehnuma Hai, Veer Tu Fakhre Khali
Be Kafan Laashe Te Zainab, Vain Kardi Rai Akhi
Maut Nai Keeta Juda, Bhul Ni Nayi Karbobala
Ban Ke Qaidi Shaam Jaandi, Payi Ye Zainab Be Rida
